## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-precision, clinical SaaS aesthetic tailored for modern nutritionists and clinical dietitians. The visual identity balances clinical authority with approachable, health-forward vitality. The personality is efficient, diagnostic, and intelligent—grounded in evidence-based practice while elevated by ambient AI capabilities.

The target audience consists of clinical dietitians, sports nutritionists, and healthcare administrators managing patient records, macro breakdowns, and teleconsultations. The interface evokes visual calm, clinical trust, and frictionless workflow speed during long consultation sessions.

The design movement blends **Corporate/Modern clinical clarity** with **subtle technological refinement**:
- Pure, pristine white card surfaces anchored over a restful slate-tinted canvas to prevent visual fatigue under fluorescent clinic lighting or long screen sessions.
- Surgical data density: tight line heights for tabular data, crisp micro-borders, and high-contrast typographic hierarchy.
- AI features and live clinical metrics are visually differentiated through luminous mint and emerald accents, avoiding generic medical tropes in favor of an active, nutrition-focused demeanor.

## Colors

The palette is engineered for clinical contrast, functional status tracking, and prolonged data review. 

### Color Roles & Semantics
- **Brand Primary (`#10B981`)**: The active workhorse. Used for primary CTAs, active plan generation, affirmative status indicators, and key metric progress arcs.
- **Primary Dark (`#065F46`)**: High-contrast corporate anchor. Applied to clinical sidebars, header navigation bands, authoritative data summaries, and high-emphasis display titles.
- **Accent / Mint (`#34D399`)**: High-energy technological glow. Reserved for automated AI suggestions, clinical completion badges, and interactive secondary feedback.
- **Canvas / Background (`#F8FAFC`)**: A cool, clinical slate base that softens optical glare in comparison to raw `#FFFFFF`.
- **Surface / Elevation (`#FFFFFF`)**: Pure white containers designated for patient charts, consultation notes, and macro calculator panels.
- **Text Primary (`#1E293B`)**: Ultra-legible dark slate meeting WCAG AAA compliance on white and light slate surfaces.
- **Text Muted (`#64748B`)**: Structural secondary copy, table headers, unit labels (e.g., `kcal`, `g/kg`), and timestamps.
- **Borders & Rules (`#E2E8F0`)**: Low-friction structural lines that organize complex meal plans without visual clutter.
- **Warning / Pending (`#F59E0B`)**: Used for missing clinical lab results, pending patient intake forms, and high-sodium/sugar alerts.
- **Info / Telehealth (`#3B82F6`)**: Dedicated channel for active teleconsultation sessions, incoming messages, and external lab integrations.

## Typography

Typography is set in **Plus Jakarta Sans** across all primary layers. Its geometric foundation combined with rounded terminal details bridges authoritative medical rigor and humanized consultation workflows.

### Hierarchical Guidelines
- **Headlines & Metric Titles**: Employ tighter tracking (`-0.02em` to `-0.03em`) and heavy weights (`700`, `800`) to present high-priority patient identifiers and summary figures with clear impact.
- **Clinical Body Copy**: Relies on relaxed line heights (22px on 14px size) to guarantee effortless readability of clinical notes, diet formulations, and biochemical annotations.
- **Data & Nutritional Units (`code-data`)**: Numerical readouts for macronutrients (carbs, proteins, fats, basal metabolic rate) utilize a monospaced font (`JetBrains Mono`) for strict vertical tabular alignment across meal planning spreadsheets.
- **Labels & Micro-copy**: Rendered in uppercase or bold weights with positive tracking (`0.02em` to `0.04em`) to establish immediate recognition for clinical categories and statuses.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout utilizes a structured 12-column responsive fluid grid designed to handle data-dense patient monitoring on desktop workstations, scaling cleanly down to tablet consultation pads and mobile emergency lookups.

### Breakpoints & Reflow Structure
- **Desktop (>= 1280px)**: 12-column grid. Left-fixed operational sidebar (260px) utilizing `Primary Dark (#065F46)`. Main clinical canvas uses `margin-desktop` (32px) and `gutter-desktop` (24px). Accommodates three-pane workflows: Patient Roster, Clinical Charting, and AI Nutrition Assistant.
- **Tablet (768px – 1279px)**: 8-column grid. Collapsible navigation bar into an icon rail (72px). Panels collapse into tabbed interfaces; `margin-tablet` (24px) and `gutter` (16px).
- **Mobile (< 768px)**: 4-column grid. Single-column stacked layouts, bottom clinical action bar, and fixed `margin` (16px). Patient overview metrics transition into swipeable carousel strips.

### Spacing Rhythm
Spacing is governed by an 8pt base grid with a 4pt sub-unit:
- Use `space-xs` (4px) and `space-sm` (8px) for internal pill chips, micro badge padding, and metric icon pairing.
- Use `space-md` (16px) for form control stacking, list item spacing, and compact clinical table cells.
- Use `space-lg` (24px) for card body padding and segmented patient dashboard blocks.
- Use `space-xl` (32px) and `space-2xl` (48px) exclusively for global section separations.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system avoids heavy shadows, instead using subtle, clinical elevation built on **pure white surfaces, delicate structural borders, and diffused light-absorption shadows**.

### Elevation Scale
- **Flat / Ground Level (`z0`)**: Canvas background (`#F8FAFC`). No shadow, no border.
- **Base Card Tier (`z1`)**: Main patient cards, macro distribution panels, and tabular records. 
  - `box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03)`
  - `border: 1px solid #E2E8F0`
- **Elevated Interactive Tier (`z2`)**: Hover states on meal plans, active patient search dropdowns, date range pickers.
  - `box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.07), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05)`
  - `border: 1px solid #CBD5E1`
- **Overlay / Modal Tier (`z3`)**: Patient intake modals, AI recipe generation drawers, telemedicine pop-outs.
  - `box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`
  - `backdrop-filter: blur(4px)` with background `#0F172A` at 40% opacity.

### Ambient AI Glow
Components generated or optimized by AI feature a faint outer ring glow rather than a dark shadow:
- `box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #34D399, 0 4px 14px 0 rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15)`

## Shapes

The design system embraces a **Rounded (Level 2)** shape standard:
- Standard UI containers (cards, form inputs, consultation summary boxes) employ `0.5rem` (8px) corner radii.
- Secondary structural layers (modals, slide-out panels, macro calculators) utilize `rounded-lg` at `1rem` (16px).
- Status badges, macro distribution counters, patient triage chips, and AI indicators strictly use `rounded-full` (9999px pill shapes) to provide visual softness against structured data grids.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Clinical Action**: Background `#10B981`, Text `#FFFFFF`, font-weight 600, border radius `0.5rem`. Hover state transitions to `#059669`. Focus ring: 2px offset with `#34D399`.
- **Institutional / Export Action**: Background `#065F46`, Text `#FFFFFF`, font-weight 600. For official medical report downloads and clinical history locks.
- **Secondary / Ghost**: Background `#FFFFFF`, Border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, Text `#1E293B`. Hover state background `#F8FAFC`.
- **AI Assist Action**: Background `linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #059669 100%)` with a leading sparkling/wand icon; inner text `#FFFFFF`.

### Chips & Pill Badges
- Strictly pill-shaped (`border-radius: 9999px`) with vertical padding of 4px and horizontal padding of 12px.
- **AI Suggested**: Background `rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.12)`, Text `#065F46`, Border `1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.3)`.
- **Pending Follow-up**: Background `rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)`, Text `#B45309`, Border `1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25)`.
- **Telehealth Active**: Background `rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1)`, Text `#1D4ED8`, Border `1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25)`. Includes a 6px pulsating status dot.

### Input Fields & Selects
- Height: 40px standard, 36px in compact clinical tables.
- Background `#FFFFFF`, Border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, Radius `0.5rem`.
- Font size `14px`, Text `#1E293B`. Placeholder text `#94A3B8`.
- Focus: Border color `#10B981`, with `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)`.

### Cards & Clinical Panels
- Surface: `#FFFFFF`, Border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, Radius `0.5rem` (8px) for modular widgets, `1rem` (16px) for master records.
- Card Header: Separated by a 1px border (`#F1F5F9`), padding 16px 20px, featuring a clear `title-md` and quick action icon buttons.

### Macronutrient Progress Bars & Visualizers
- Segmented linear tracks for **Carbohydrates**, **Proteins**, and **Fats**:
  - Background track: `#F1F5F9`, height: 8px, border radius: 9999px.
  - Protein fill: `#10B981` (Emerald).
  - Carbohydrate fill: `#3B82F6` (Blue).
  - Fat/Lipid fill: `#F59E0B` (Amber).
  - Integrated tabular readout displaying current intake vs target (e.g., `142g / 160g`) in `code-data` typography.

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Size: 18x18px. Radius: 4px for checkboxes, circular for radios.
- Border: `1.5px solid #CBD5E1`. Checked state: Background `#10B981` with white checkmark/dot.

### Clinical Data Tables
- Row height: 48px for clean scanning.
- Alternating row interaction: Hover row background `#F8FAFC`.
- Table Header: Text `#64748B`, font-weight 700, size `11px`, letter-spacing `0.04em`, uppercase, bottom border `1px solid #E2E8F0`.
